config.title: Guy's Moving Sale
config.subtitle: We're moving out of New York — furniture, lighting and a few odds and ends, all looking for a new home. Most items have only been used for a year.
config.availability: Many items available end of September. Some items available immediately — please inquire.
config.note: Pickup only, from 72nd and York on the Upper East Side. First come, first served. Cash or Venmo. Happy to do a deal on bundles — take the whole living room and I'll make it worth your while.

items.title: Blue sectional sofa
items.description: Beautiful sectional in great condition. Pillows can be included.

items.title: 65" flat-screen TV
items.description: 65-inch flat-screen TV, currently on the media console. Bought new about a year ago for $380.

items.title: White wooden crib with mattress
items.description: Classic white slatted crib with an adjustable mattress base, IKEA style. In good condition. Comes with a Moonlight Slumber Little Dreamers mattress, used for under a year.

items.title: Outdoor wicker sofa
items.description: Two-seat balcony sofa in dark brown all-weather wicker on a steel frame, with thick grey outdoor cushions. Has lived on a covered balcony. Cushions and pillow included.

items.title: Coway Airmega air purifier
items.description: Coway Airmega HEPA air purifier in white. One year old and in excellent condition. Quiet, good for a bedroom or nursery.

items.title: Light oak media console / TV stand
items.description: Wide low console in pale oak with four drawers and a fluted centre cabinet with a diamond motif. Plenty of storage for media and toys.

items.title: Set of 3 framed abstract prints
items.description: Three large graphic prints in slim black frames — blue and red stripes, an orange and teal landscape, and a black dash pattern. Sold as a set.

items.title: Upholstered bed
items.description: Wingback-style upholstered headboard in a warm rust fabric on a matching platform frame with dark wood legs. Queen size. Excellent mattress included — two years old, lightly used.

items.title: Oak side table with drawer
items.description: Rounded-corner side table in pale oak with one drawer and an open lower shelf. Sits nicely next to a sofa.

items.title: Electric standing desk
items.description: Height-adjustable sit-stand desk with a warm wood top and a white steel frame. Motor and controller included.

items.title: Grey upholstered armchair
items.description: Comfortable reading chair, swivels, great condition.

items.title: Oak nightstand, two drawers
items.description: Solid wood.

items.title: White diaper changing table
items.description: White changing table with a padded changing pad on top and two open shelves below — room for diapers, wipes and baskets. Baskets and contents not included.

items.title: Large living room rug
items.description: Big flatweave area rug in cream with a soft grey grid and stripe pattern. Machine washable and in great condition.

items.title: Wood tripod floor lamp
items.description: Tall lamp on a light wood tripod base with a large cream drum shade. Warm, even light.

items.title: Grey bouclé nursery rocking chair
items.description: High-backed nursery rocker in soft grey bouclé with a wingback shape and pale wood rockers. Comfortable for night feeds and bedtime stories. Cushion included.

items.title: Mesh office chair
items.description: Beige mesh-back task chair with armrests, height adjustment and castors.

items.title: Brushed nickel floor lamp
items.description: Slim metal floor lamp with a large white drum shade.

items.title: Adjustable metal floor lamp
items.description: Nickel-finish reading lamp with a jointed arm and a domed shade, IKEA Ranarp style. Swings out over a sofa or chair.

items.title: Nesting side tables, set of 2
items.description: Pair of pebble-shaped nesting tables with light wood legs — one white top, one charcoal. Use them together or apart.

items.title: Wood tripod table lamp
items.description: Small tripod lamp in light wood with a linen drum shade. Matches the larger tripod floor lamp.

items.title: Desk lamp
items.description: Adjustable brass-finish desk lamp with a dome shade, vintage bankers style.

items.title: Striped area rug
items.description: Flatweave area rug in cream with stepped grey stripes. Low pile, lies flat and vacuums easily.

items.title: White storage drawer unit
items.description: Rolling plastic drawer cart with six shallow drawers, used beside the desk.

items.title: Green round metal side table
items.description: Small round side table in sage-green powder-coated metal with splayed legs. Light enough to move with one hand, fine indoors or on a balcony.

items.title: IKEA Antilop high chair
items.description: The classic white high chair with a tray and removable support cushion. Wipes clean, easy to disassemble.

items.title: Green table lamp
items.description: Small dark green table lamp with an uplit cylinder shade. Currently on the bedside tray table.

items.title: Round tray side table
items.description: Grey metal side table with a removable round tray top, IKEA Gladom style. Used as a nightstand.

items.title: Table lamp
items.description: Compact bedside lamp with a turned wood base and a small drum shade.
